install_steps: Run: sc n8n-cli self setup  — configure n8n workspace (interactive)
Run: sc n8n-cli self mcp     — register MCP server for agent use
Then: sc n8n-cli workflow list  — list workflows
Or use the MCP server for agent-driven workflow management
note: Wraps n8nac CLI from EtienneLescot/n8n-as-code (MIT). Requires n8n instance URL + API key.
